check_na.name: python_tests
check_na.rationale: Cannot pass locally on Windows. Two categories, neither caused by this diff. (1) Eight Learning Center tests fail identically on unmodified origin/main — issue #2075, test-side: shutil.rmtree over read-only git objects, CRLF text fixtures, an OS-separator path comparison, and a symlink privilege. (2) Five workflow-execution and websocket tests (test_system_vertical, test_workflows) are load-dependent under xdist: they failed in a 234s run, passed in a 163s run of the same commit, and all five pass in isolation. This diff touches scistudio.tutorials, the docs generators, and two type annotations; nothing on the execution or websocket path. The tests it adds pass, and the full public-surface suite passes. CI is Ubuntu-only, green on the same base, and runs this check authoritatively.

check_na.name: semantic_dup
check_na.rationale: Times out inside the gate runner on this machine (four attempts, all 'execution error: TimeoutExpired', exit_code null — no verdict, not a failure). The scan needs about 103s, dominated by loading the BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 model and embedding 2372 functions; a warm model cache did not bring it under the gate's per-check timeout. Run directly it passes: exit 0, 'OK: all ratchets within limits', 125 clusters against a 150 limit, 11.28% duplicate against a 13.83% limit, max cluster size 8 against a limit of 8. CI runs this check authoritatively.
